Ananya Subramanian
AI/ML Developer
Chennai, India | +91 91234 56780 | ananya.subramanian@outlook.com | linkedin.com/in/ananya-subramanian
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Detail-oriented AI Developer focused on computer vision and conversational AI systems, with a strong
foundation in applied mathematics.
SKILLS
•
Python, NumPy, OpenCV
•
Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs)
•
TensorFlow, Keras
•
Speech-to-text & NLP pipelines
•
Model optimization (ONNX, quantization)
•
Git, CI/CD for ML (GitHub Actions)
•
Cloud ML (Azure ML, GCP Vertex AI)
WORK EXPERIENCE
AI Engineer — VisionEdge Labs
Jan 2022 - Present
•
Designed a defect-detection CV model for manufacturing line cameras, reducing false negatives by 22%
•
Optimized inference latency from 400ms to 90ms using model quantization and ONNX runtime
•
Built a voice-assistant module integrating Whisper STT with a custom NLU layer
Data Science Intern — Quantica Insights
May 2021 - Dec 2021
•
Built dashboards summarizing model performance metrics for stakeholders
•
Cleaned and labeled image datasets of 50K+ samples for training pipelines
PROJECTS
Smart Attendance System
Face-recognition based attendance system using OpenCV and a custom-trained CNN, deployed on Raspberry Pi
Chat Assistant for Healthcare FAQs
Built an intent-classification chatbot using spaCy and Rasa for a clinic's patient queries
EDUCATION
B.E, Information Technology — Anna University
2018 - 2022
CERTIFICATIONS
•
Coursera - Deep Learning Specialization (Andrew Ng)
•
NPTEL - Computer Vision
